name: pdf-translate
title_zh: 扫描件里的正文也能翻，版式公式图表原样留
tagline_zh: 图片型扫描件不再只能干瞪眼——正文安全翻成越南语等拉丁语系，公式图表一张不挪。术语敏感时还能手动交接。
tagline_en: Finally translate image-only scans: prose comes out safe, formulas/tables/figures stay put. Batch-ready.
desc_en: Translate local PDFs, including safe prose on image-only scans, into Vietnamese or another supported Latin-script language while preserving layout, formulas, tables, and figures. Use for PDF translation, OCR-assisted scan translation, batch translation, terminology-sensitive handoff translation, or diagnosing incomplete output. Do not use for targets requiring CJK, right-to-left, or complex-script
why_zh: 不是粗暴整页OCR重排，而是分层处理：正文走翻译、版式走保留，公式图表当图钉住。翻完会自检。
why_en: Layered pipeline: prose translated, layout preserved, formulas/figures pinned as images. Self-checks output and flags incomplete.
limit_zh: 目标语言仅限拉丁字母拼写体系（越南语、法语等）；中文、阿拉伯文、复杂文字直接不适用。图片型扫描件需清晰可辨。
limit_en: Latin-script targets only (Vietnamese, French, etc.); no CJK, RTL, or complex scripts. Scans must be legible—handwriting or low DPI causes misses.
title_en: Translate scanned PDFs, keep layout, formulas, tables intact
